targets.authors: Spaniel F, Horáček J, Tintěra J, Ibrahim I, Novák T, Čermák J, Klírová M, Höschl C
targets.title: Genetic variation in FOXP2 alters grey matter concentrations in schizophrenia patients
targets.evidence_quote: Second, we performed a replication study of earlier MRI findings of the influence of this SNP on brain structure (Spaniel et al. 2011 ), using a larger and more homogenous sample.
targets.outcome_quote: The GM deficits were more extensive in the AC schizophrenia patients, affecting the PFC, the anterior and median cingulate and the paracingulate gyri, which suggested that reduction in the GM concentration in schizophrenia may be driven by the C allele. Our results replicated these findings and further showed differences in FOXP2 expression depending on rs2396753, linking for the first time low FOXP2 expression to GM density reductions.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly state that the neuroimaging findings replicated. The new expression analysis is an extension, not another original target.

reasoning: Independent MRI sample re-tests Spaniel et al.; other cited genetic association studies are background.
